name: FPOne Intranet
description: FPOne Intranet da Fazenda Progresso com Next.js 16 Standalone, PostgreSQL 16, Garage S3 e autenticação Active Directory (LDAP).

configFiles.content:
metadata_dir = "/var/lib/garage/meta"
data_dir = "/var/lib/garage/data"
db_engine = "sqlite"
replication_factor = 1

rpc_bind_addr = "[::]:3901"
rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"
rpc_secret = "${GARAGE_RPC_SECRET}"

[s3_api]
s3_region = "garage"
api_bind_addr = "[::]:3900"
root_domain = ".s3.local"

[s3_web]
bind_addr = "[::]:3902"
root_domain = ".web.local"

[admin]
api_bind_addr = "[::]:3903"
admin_token = "${GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN}"

data.env:
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@$(PROJECT_NAME)_db:5432/$(PROJECT_NAME)
GARAGE_ENDPOINT=http://$(PROJECT_NAME)_garage:3900
MINIO_ENDPOINT=http://$(PROJECT_NAME)_garage:3900
S3_BUCKET=fpone-files
S3_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_ACCESS_KEY}
S3_SECRET_KEY=${S3_SECRET_KEY}
S3_PUBLIC_URL=https://$(PRIMARY_DOMAIN)
AUTH_SECRET=${AUTH_SECRET}
AUTH_URL=https://$(PRIMARY_DOMAIN)
AUTH_TRUST_HOST=true
AUTH_SESSION_HOURS=8
TRUST_PROXY=true
CPF_PEPPER=${CPF_PEPPER}
TZ=America/Bahia
MASTER_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
MASTER_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${MASTER_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
AD_ENABLED=true
AD_HOST=192.168.77.250
AD_PORT=389
AD_URL=ldap://192.168.77.250:389
AD_BASE_DN=dc=fazendaprogresso,dc=com,dc=local
AD_BIND_DN=FP\glpi
AD_BIND_PASSWORD=${AD_BIND_PASSWORD}
AD_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE=sAMAccountName
AD_USER_FILTER=(&(objectClass=user)(objectCategory=person)(!(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2)))
AD_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=5000
AD_OPERATION_TIMEOUT=10000
AD_USE_TLS=false
LDAP_HOST=192.168.77.250
LDAP_PORT=389
LDAP_SECURITY=none
LDAP_BASE_DN=dc=fazendaprogresso,dc=com,dc=local
LDAP_BIND_DN=FP\glpi
LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD=${AD_BIND_PASSWORD}
LDAP_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE=sAMAccountName
LDAP_USER_FILTER=(&(objectClass=user)(objectCategory=person)(!(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2)))
LDAP_TIMEOUT_MS=5000
LDAP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=5000
LDAP_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=true
LOGIN_MAX_FAILS_PER_USER=5
LOGIN_MAX_FAILS_PER_IP=20
LOGIN_RATE_WINDOW_MINUTES=15
AUDIT_RETENTION_MONTHS=24
DEMO_MODE=false
FEATURE_AI_SEARCH=false
NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANY_NAME=Fazenda Progresso
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production
GLPI_TICKET_URL=
